Name: Blue Collar Valley Music Pack (Content Patcher)
Author: TitanmasterRy
Description:
[b]Blue Collar Valley — A Working-Class Music Replacer[/b]
Pelican Town wasn't built by daydreamers. It was built by calloused hands, early mornings, and the kind of people who clock in before sunrise and don't quit until the work's done. This mod swaps out the soundtrack for something that matches that grit — music for farmers, miners, and anyone who knows the smell of honest sweat.
No frills. No polish. Just the steady rhythm of a place that earns its keep.
[b]What it changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Main menu[/b] — the first thing you hear when you sit down after a long day[/*]
[*][b]Load / character select screen[/b] — a quiet moment before the shift starts[/*]
[*][b]Ambient track[/b] — the background hum of a valley that never really stops working[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]Drop it in your Mods folder and get back to work.

Downloads.Description: Drag and drop into mods folder (MUST HAVE CONTENT PATCHER!!!)

Manifest.Name: Blue Collar Valley
Manifest.Description: Custom main menu background, main menu music, ambient music, and select music.
